words.ex: The telescope saw gas clouds in space.
words.ex_cn: 望远镜看到了太空中的气体云。
words.en: Gas clouds are vast regions of gas and dust in space, often found in galaxies, where they can be the birthplace of new stars.

words.tr: n. 双子座（黄道十二宫之一）；双胞胎之一
words.ex: He was born under the sign of Gemini.
words.ex_cn: 他出生在双子座。
words.en: In astrology, Gemini is the third sign of the zodiac, symbolized by the twins, and is associated with people born between May 21 and June 20. Geminis are often characterized as adaptable, versatile, and communicative.

words.tr: phrase. 球状星团（由成千上万颗恒星组成的、呈球形的密集星团，通常围绕星系核心运行）
words.ex: The telescope showed a globular cluster in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 望远镜在夜空中显示了一个球状星团。
words.en: A globular cluster is a spherical collection of stars that orbits a galactic core as a satellite. Globular clusters are very tightly bound by gravity, which gives them their spherical shapes and relatively high stellar densities toward their centers.

words.tr:
int. 喂；哈喽；
n. “喂”的招呼声或问候声；
words.ex: Hello, can you hear me?
words.ex_cn: 喂，你能听到我吗？
words.en: used as a greeting or to begin a telephone conversation

words.ex: The boat floats at high tide.
words.ex_cn: 在涨潮时，船会浮起来。
words.en: The time at which the tide is at its highest level.

words.ex: The fisherman walks on the beach at low tide.
words.ex_cn: 渔民在低潮时走在海滩上。
words.en: Low tide is the time when the sea is at its lowest level because the tide is out.

words.ex: The prime meridian passes through Greenwich, England.
words.ex_cn: 本初子午线穿过英国格林尼治。
words.en: A meridian is an imaginary great circle on the earth's surface passing through the north and south poles at right angles to the equator, or the highest point reached by a celestial or other object.

words.ex: We saw a meteor shower last night.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨晚看到了流星雨。
words.en: A meteor shower is a celestial event in which a number of meteors are observed to radiate, or originate, from one point in the night sky.

words.ex: The meteor stream shines brightly at night.
words.ex_cn: 流星雨在夜晚明亮地闪耀。
words.en: A meteor stream is a group of meteors that appear to radiate from one point in the sky, caused by the Earth passing through a trail of debris left by a comet.

words.ex: The ancient tool was made of obsidian.
words.ex_cn: 这个古代工具是由黑曜石制成的。
words.en: Obsidian is a naturally occurring volcanic glass formed as an extrusive igneous rock.

words.tr: phrase. 轨道能量；原子或分子中电子在轨道上的能量
words.ex: The electron has high orbital energy.
words.ex_cn: 这个电子具有较高的轨道能量。
words.en: Orbital energy refers to the energy associated with the motion of an object in an orbit around another object, such as an electron around a nucleus in an atom.

words.ex: The parallax makes the star look like it moves.
words.ex_cn: 视差使恒星看起来在移动。
words.en: The apparent displacement or the difference in apparent direction of an object as seen from two different points not on a straight line with the object.

words.ex: The plant responds to the photoperiod by flowering.
words.ex_cn: 植物通过光周期来开花。
words.en: The length of day and night as it affects the biological functions of organisms.

words.tr: phrase. 行星引力场；行星重力场
words.ex: The planet has a strong planetary gravitational field.
words.ex_cn: 这个行星有一个强大的行星引力场。
words.en: The area around a planet where its gravitational force is dominant, influencing the motion of objects within it.

words.ex: The Pleistocene epoch had many ice ages.
words.ex_cn: 更新世时期有许多冰河时代。
words.en: The Pleistocene is the geological epoch which lasted from about 2,588,000 to 11,700 years ago, spanning the world's recent period of repeated glaciations.

words.ex: The telescope detected a faint protogalaxy in the early universe.
words.ex_cn: 望远镜在早期宇宙中探测到一个微弱的原星系。
words.en: A protogalaxy is a cloud of gas which is in the process of forming a galaxy.

words.tr: n. 脉冲星；（快速）脉冲射电源
words.ex: The telescope detected a pulsar in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 望远镜在夜空中探测到一颗脉冲星。
words.en: A pulsar is a highly magnetized, rotating neutron star that emits beams of electromagnetic radiation out of its magnetic poles.

words.ex: The quasar is very far away and very bright.
words.ex_cn: 这个类星体非常遥远且非常明亮。
words.en: A quasar is a massive and extremely remote celestial object, emitting exceptionally large amounts of energy, and typically having a star-like image in a telescope.

words.tr: phrase. 射电星系；发出强烈无线电波辐射的星系
words.ex: The radio galaxy emits strong radio waves.
words.ex_cn: 这个射电星系发射出强烈的无线电波。
words.en: A radio galaxy is a type of galaxy that emits large amounts of radio waves from its core, often associated with the presence of a supermassive black hole.

words.ex: The climbers put on rock plates for safety.
words.ex_cn: 登山者穿上岩板以确保安全。
words.en: Thin, flat layers of rock, often used in construction or as decorative surfaces.

words.ex: He uses rock salt to melt ice on the driveway.
words.ex_cn: 他用岩盐融化车道上的冰。
words.en: Rock salt is the mineral form of sodium chloride (NaCl), also known as halite. It is commonly used in de-icing roads and walkways, as well as in food preservation.

words.ex: He climbed the sierra with his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他和朋友们爬了山。
words.en: A sierra is a mountain range, especially in Spain or Spanish America.

words.tr: phrase. 螺旋星系（指具有旋臂结构的星系）
words.ex: The telescope shows two spiral galaxies in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 望远镜在夜空中显示了两个旋涡星系。
words.en: Spiral galaxies are a type of galaxy characterized by a flat, rotating disk containing stars, gas, and dust, and a central concentration of stars known as the bulge. They are named for the spiral structures that extend from the center into the disk.

words.tr: n. 平流层；同温层；最高层；
words.ex: Planes fly in the stratosphere to avoid bad weather.
words.ex_cn: 飞机在平流层飞行以避开恶劣天气。
words.en: The stratosphere is the second major layer of Earth's atmosphere, just above the troposphere, and below the mesosphere. It is characterized by a slight temperature increase with altitude and the presence of the ozone layer, which absorbs and scatters the solar ultraviolet radiation.

words.tr: phrase. 地下地质学；研究地表以下岩层结构、组成和历史的地质学科
words.ex: The team studied subsurface geology to find water.
words.ex_cn: 团队研究了地下地质以寻找水。
words.en: The study of the physical properties and processes of the Earth's subsurface, including the analysis of rock layers, structures, and resources.

words.tr: phrase. 银河系；乳白色的星系带（指横跨夜空的银河）
words.ex: The milky way is a big band of light in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 银河是夜空中的一条明亮光带。
words.en: The Milky Way is the galaxy that contains our Solar System, appearing as a hazy band of light in the night sky.

words.tr: phrase. 潮汐周期；指潮水涨落的完整循环过程
words.ex: The tidal cycle changes twice a day.
words.ex_cn: 潮汐周期每天变化两次。
words.en: The regular rise and fall of the sea level caused by the gravitational interactions between the Earth, the Moon, and the Sun.

words.tr: phrase. 白矮星：一种低光度、高密度、小体积的恒星残骸，是中等质量恒星演化末期的产物
words.ex: The white dwarf star is very small and very old.
words.ex_cn: 这颗白矮星非常小而且非常古老。
words.en: A white dwarf star is a small, very dense star that is typically the size of a planet. It is the final evolutionary state of stars like the Sun, after they have exhausted their nuclear fuel and shed their outer layers.

chapters.name: 附录二 GMAT 阅读词汇分类 生物类

words.ex: Adenosine helps regulate heart rate.
words.ex_cn: 腺苷有助于调节心率。
words.en: Adenosine is a nucleoside composed of adenine and ribose, and it is a component of ATP, ADP, and AMP, playing a critical role in energy transfer within cells.

words.tr: adj. 需氧的；好氧的；有氧的；
words.ex: Running is an aerobic exercise.
words.ex_cn: 跑步是有氧运动。
words.en: Aerobic exercise is physical exercise of relatively low intensity that depends primarily on the aerobic energy-generating process.

words.ex: The peanuts had aflatoxin and were unsafe to eat.
words.ex_cn: 这些花生含有黄曲霉毒素，不能安全食用。
words.en: Aflatoxin is a type of mycotoxin produced by certain species of Aspergillus, particularly Aspergillus flavus and Aspergillus parasiticus. It is known for its potent carcinogenic effects and can contaminate a variety of food products, leading to serious health risks when ingested.

words.ex: Proteins are made of amino acids.
words.ex_cn: 蛋白质由氨基酸组成。
words.en: An amino acid is a type of organic acid that contains both a carboxyl group and an amino group, and is a basic component of proteins.

words.tr: n. [生物][微] 厌氧性生物，[微] 厌氧菌
words.ex: The anaerobe lives in soil without oxygen.
words.ex_cn: 这种厌氧菌生活在无氧的土壤中。
words.en: An organism that does not require oxygen for growth and may even die in its presence.

words.ex: Anaerobic bacteria can live without oxygen.
words.ex_cn: 无氧细菌可以在没有氧气的情况下生存。
words.en: relating to or requiring an absence of free oxygen

words.tr: phrase. 无氧代谢；指在无氧条件下通过分解有机物产生能量的代谢过程
words.ex: The runner uses anaerobic metabolism during a short sprint.
words.ex_cn: 跑步者在短跑时使用无氧代谢。
words.en: The process by which the body produces energy through the breakdown of glucose without the use of oxygen.

words.tr: phrase. 生物防治剂；用于控制害虫或病原体的生物体，如天敌、寄生菌或竞争性微生物
words.ex: Farmers use biocontrol agents to kill pests naturally.
words.ex_cn: 农民使用生物控制剂来自然地消灭害虫。
words.en: Biocontrol agents are organisms used to control pest populations, including insects, mites, weeds, and plant diseases, through predation, parasitism, or other natural mechanisms.

words.tr: phrase. 细胞伸长；指细胞在生长过程中沿某一方向延长的现象
words.ex: The plant shows cell elongation under sunlight.
words.ex_cn: 植物在阳光下表现出细胞伸长。
words.en: The process by which cells increase in length, especially in plants, as a result of water uptake and the expansion of the cell wall.

words.ex: The cell nucleus contains DNA.
words.ex_cn: 细胞核含有DNA。
words.en: The central and most important part of a cell, containing genetic material.

words.ex: The cytoplasm is inside the cell.
words.ex_cn: 细胞质在细胞内部。
words.en: The cytoplasm is the material or protoplasm within a living cell, excluding the nucleus.

words.ex: Running releases endorphin and makes you happy.
words.ex_cn: 跑步会释放内啡肽，让你感到快乐。
words.en: Endorphins are chemicals produced naturally by the nervous system to cope with pain or stress. They are often called 'feel-good' chemicals because they can act as pain relievers and happiness boosters.

words.tr: n. 真核细胞（等于 eucaryote）
words.ex: A plant cell is a eukaryote.
words.ex_cn: 植物细胞是一种真核生物。
words.en: A eukaryote is any organism whose cells contain a nucleus and other organelles enclosed within membranes.

words.ex: The plant cell is eukaryotic.
words.ex_cn: 这个植物细胞是真核细胞。
words.en: Relating to or characteristic of a eukaryote, an organism whose cells contain a nucleus and other organelles enclosed within membranes.

words.ex: Histidine is an amino acid in protein.
words.ex_cn: 组氨酸是蛋白质中的一种氨基酸。
words.en: An essential amino acid, C6H9N3O2, important for the growth and repair of tissues, and a precursor of histamine.

words.ex: The enzyme works inside the cell, in the intracellular space.
words.ex_cn: 这种酶在细胞内部的细胞内空间中起作用。
words.en: Existing, occurring, or functioning within a cell or cells.

words.ex: Muscles produce lactic acid during exercise.
words.ex_cn: 肌肉在运动时会产生乳酸。
words.en: Lactic acid is an organic acid that forms when certain bacteria ferment carbohydrates, or it is produced in muscle cells from the fermentation of glucose during strenuous exercise.

words.tr: n. [生化] 亮氨酸；白氨酸
words.ex: He eats eggs to get more leucine.
words.ex_cn: 他吃鸡蛋以获取更多的亮氨酸。
words.en: Leucine is an essential amino acid that is important for protein synthesis and muscle repair.

words.ex: Lipoproteins play a crucial role in transporting fats in the blood.
words.ex_cn: 脂蛋白在血液中运输脂肪过程中起着至关重要的作用。
words.en: A lipoprotein is a biochemical assembly whose primary purpose is to transport hydrophobic lipid molecules in water, as in blood plasma or other extracellular fluids.

words.ex: The macrophage eats bacteria in the blood.
words.ex_cn: 巨噬细胞吞噬血液中的细菌。
words.en: A macrophage is a type of white blood cell that is an important part of the immune system. It engulfs and digests cellular debris, foreign substances, microbes, and cancer cells in a process called phagocytosis.

words.ex: Messenger RNA carries instructions from DNA to make proteins.
words.ex_cn: 信使RNA将DNA的指令传递过来以制造蛋白质。
words.en: Messenger RNA (mRNA) is a type of RNA that conveys genetic information from DNA to the ribosome, where they specify the amino acid sequence of the protein products of gene expression.

words.tr: phrase. 分子生物学（研究生物大分子结构与功能的学科）
words.ex: He works in a lab that studies molecular biology.
words.ex_cn: 他在一个研究分子生物学的实验室工作。
words.en: Molecular biology is the branch of biology that deals with the molecular basis of biological activity.

words.ex: DNA is made of many nucleotides.
words.ex_cn: DNA由许多核苷酸组成。
words.en: A nucleotide is one of the structural components, or building blocks, of DNA and RNA. A nucleotide consists of a base (one of four chemicals: adenine, thymine, guanine, and cytosine) plus a molecule of sugar and one of phosphoric acid.

words.ex: The cell has many organelles that do different jobs.
words.ex_cn: 细胞有许多执行不同功能的细胞器。
words.en: An organelle is a specialized subunit within a cell that has a specific function, and is usually separately enclosed within its own lipid bilayer.

words.ex: The ovarian follicle releases an egg each month.
words.ex_cn: 卵巢滤泡每个月释放一个卵子。
words.en: A small sac in the ovary in which an egg develops.

words.ex: The peptide helps the body heal faster.
words.ex_cn: 这种肽帮助身体更快愈合。
words.en: A peptide is a compound consisting of two or more amino acids linked in a chain, the carboxyl group of each acid being joined to the amino group of the next by a bond known as a peptide bond.

words.ex: Ants leave a pheromone trail to find their way home.
words.ex_cn: 蚂蚁留下信息素痕迹来找到回家的路。
words.en: A pheromone is a chemical substance produced and released into the environment by an animal, especially a mammal or an insect, affecting the behavior or physiology of others of its species.

words.tr: phrase. 浆细胞（一种能产生抗体的免疫细胞）
words.ex: The plasma cell makes antibodies to fight infection.
words.ex_cn: 浆细胞产生抗体以对抗感染。
words.en: A plasma cell is a type of white blood cell that produces large volumes of antibodies. It is the mature form of B cells, which are part of the immune system.

words.tr: n. 多形体；多晶型物；同质异像体；多态生物，多态无机物；多型核细胞
words.ex: The insect is a polymorph with different shapes.
words.ex_cn: 这种昆虫是一种具有不同形态的多态生物。
words.en: A polymorph is a substance or organism that can exist in several different forms or shapes.

words.ex: The prokaryotic cell has no nucleus.
words.ex_cn: 原核细胞没有细胞核。
words.en: A prokaryotic cell is a type of cell that does not have a true nucleus or membrane-bound organelles. Organisms within the domains Bacteria and Archaea are based on the prokaryotic cell, which is the earliest and most primitive form of life on Earth.

words.ex: The cell contains protoplasm.
words.ex_cn: 细胞中含有原生质。
words.en: The colorless material comprising the living part of a cell, including the cytoplasm, nucleus, and other organelles.

words.ex: The ribosome makes proteins in the cell.
words.ex_cn: 核糖体在细胞中制造蛋白质。
words.en: A ribosome is a minute particle consisting of RNA and associated proteins, found in large numbers in the cytoplasm of living cells. They bind messenger RNA and transfer RNA to synthesize polypeptides and proteins.

words.ex: Bananas contain tryptophan, which helps you sleep.
words.ex_cn: 香蕉含有色氨酸，有助于你入睡。
words.en: Tryptophan is an essential amino acid that is important for the synthesis of proteins and the production of serotonin, a neurotransmitter that affects mood and sleep.

words.ex: Tyrosine is an amino acid in milk.
words.ex_cn: 酪氨酸是牛奶中的一种氨基酸。
words.en: Tyrosine is an amino acid that is a precursor to several important neurotransmitters, including dopamine, norepinephrine, and epinephrine.

chapters.name: 附录二 GMAT 阅读词汇分类 动植物类

words.ex: The archaeopteryx had feathers and could fly a little.
words.ex_cn: 始祖鸟有羽毛，能飞一点。
words.en: Archaeopteryx is a genus of bird-like dinosaurs that is transitional between non-avian feathered dinosaurs and modern birds.

words.tr: n. [无脊椎] 藤壶；茗荷介；难以摆脱的人；黑雁
words.ex: The barnacle sticks to the bottom of the boat.
words.ex_cn: 藤壶粘在船底。
words.en: A barnacle is a type of arthropod constituting the infraclass Cirripedia in the subphylum Crustacea, and is hence related to crabs and lobsters. Barnacles are exclusively marine, and tend to live in shallow and tidal waters, typically in erosive settings.

words.tr:
adj. 两足动物的
n. 两足动物
words.ex: The robot walks in a bipedal way.
words.ex_cn: 这个机器人以双足的方式行走。
words.en: Relating to or using two feet or legs for walking.

words.tr: phrase. 棉铃象鼻虫（一种严重危害棉花作物的害虫）
words.ex: The boll weevil destroyed many cotton fields.
words.ex_cn: 棉铃虫摧毁了许多棉田。
words.en: A small beetle that feeds on cotton buds and flowers, known for causing significant damage to cotton crops.

words.tr: n. 一种蛾的幼虫；螟蛉虫
words.ex: The farmer sprayed poison to kill the bollworm.
words.ex_cn: 农民喷了杀虫剂来杀死棉铃虫。
words.en: A bollworm is a type of moth larva that attacks the bolls of cotton plants, causing significant damage to the crops.

words.ex: The bowerbird builds a colorful nest to attract a mate.
words.ex_cn: 园丁鸟建造一个五彩缤纷的巢来吸引配偶。
words.en: A bowerbird is a type of bird known for its unique behavior of building and decorating a structure, known as a bower, to attract mates.

words.ex: I eat broccoli with dinner every day.
words.ex_cn: 我每天晚餐都吃西兰花。
words.en: Broccoli is a vegetable with a green flower head and a thick stalk, eaten as a vegetable.

words.ex: The budworm eats leaves on the trees.
words.ex_cn: 芽虫吃树上的叶子。
words.en: A budworm is the larva of a moth that feeds on the buds of plants, often causing significant damage to crops.

words.ex: The cheetah runs very fast in the wild.
words.ex_cn: 猎豹在野外跑得非常快。
words.en: A cheetah is a large, slender, spotted cat found in Africa and parts of Iran. It is the fastest land animal, capable of running at speeds up to about 100 kilometers per hour (62 miles per hour) in short bursts covering distances up to 500 meters (1,600 feet), and has the ability to accelerate from 0 to 100 km/h (62 mph) in just three seconds.

words.tr:
n. 柑橘类果实；
adj. 柑橘类果实的；
words.ex: He loves eating citrus like oranges and lemons.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢吃柑橘类果实，比如橙子和柠檬。
words.en: Citrus is a genus of flowering trees and shrubs in the rue family, Rutaceae. Plants in the genus produce citrus fruits, including important crops such as oranges, lemons, grapefruits, pomelos, and limes.

words.ex: The cornstalk is tall and green.
words.ex_cn: 玉米秆又高又绿。
words.en: A cornstalk is the stem of a corn plant, which remains after the corn has been harvested.

words.tr: n. 郊狼；丛林狼；草原狼；
words.ex: The coyote ran across the desert at night.
words.ex_cn: 那只郊狼在夜晚跑过沙漠。
words.en: A coyote is a wild dog that looks like a wolf and lives in North America.

words.tr: n. 越橘；小红莓；蔓越莓；蔓越橘
words.ex: He eats cranberry sauce with turkey at Thanksgiving.
words.ex_cn: 他在感恩节吃火鸡配蔓越莓酱。
words.en: A cranberry is a small, red, acid berry used in cooking.

words.ex: The diatom is a major component of marine phytoplankton.
words.ex_cn: 硅藻是海洋浮游植物的主要组成部分。
words.en: A diatom is a type of single-celled algae that has a cell wall made of silica. Diatoms are found in oceans, waterways, and soils all over the world and are an important part of the aquatic food chain.

words.tr: phrase. 生态位；生态龛；指一个物种在生态系统中所占据的位置及其与环境和其他物种之间的功能关系
words.ex: The ecological niche of the panda is primarily in bamboo forests.
words.ex_cn: 熊猫的生态位主要在竹林中。
words.en: An ecological niche refers to the role and position a species has in its environment; how it meets its needs for food and shelter, how it survives, and how it reproduces.

words.ex: The gecko clung to the wall effortlessly.
words.ex_cn: 壁虎毫不费力地贴在墙上。
words.en: A gecko is a small to medium-sized lizard belonging to the family Gekkonidae, found in warm climates throughout the world. They are known for their vocalizations and their ability to climb smooth and vertical surfaces and even cross indoor ceilings with ease.

words.tr: n. 海鸠；海雀; n. （Guillemot）人名；（法）吉耶莫；（西）吉列莫特
words.ex: The guillemot is a type of seabird that often nests on cliffs.
words.ex_cn: 海鸠是一种常在悬崖上筑巢的海鸟。
words.en: A guillemot is a seabird of the auk family, typically having a black or gray body with white underparts.

words.tr: n. [鱼]黑线鳕（鳕的一种）; n. （Haddock）人名；（英）哈多克；（葡）阿多克
words.ex: The fishmonger recommended haddock for tonight's dinner.
words.ex_cn: 鱼贩推荐今晚的晚餐用黑线鳕。
words.en: A haddock is a type of edible fish found in the North Atlantic Ocean.

words.ex: The child caught a lepidopter in the garden.
words.ex_cn: 孩子在花园里抓到一只鳞翅类昆虫。
words.en: Lepidopter refers to any of numerous insects of the order Lepidoptera, including butterflies and moths, characterized by four large, scale-covered wings that are typically brightly colored.

words.ex: The lepidoptera includes butterflies and moths.
words.ex_cn: 鳞翅目包括蝴蝶和蛾。
words.en: Lepidoptera is an order of insects that includes moths and butterflies. They are characterized by their large, often brightly colored wings covered with scales.

words.tr: n. 猕猴，恒河猴；短尾猿
words.ex: The macaque is a common species of monkey found in Asia.
words.ex_cn: 猕猴是亚洲常见的一种猴子。
words.en: A macaque is a type of monkey that is native to Asia, known for its adaptability and social behavior.

words.tr:
n. 猛玛（象）；庞然大物；
adj. 巨大的；庞大的；
words.ex: The mammoth lived in cold areas long ago.
words.ex_cn: 猛犸象很久以前生活在寒冷地区。
words.en: If you describe something as mammoth, you are emphasizing that it is extremely large.

words.ex: Marine invertebrates include a wide variety of species such as starfish, jellyfish, and sea urchins.
words.ex_cn: 海洋无脊椎动物包括许多种类的物种，如海星、水母和海胆。
words.en: Marine invertebrates are animals without a backbone that live in the ocean. They include a wide variety of species, such as jellyfish, corals, and sea stars, and play essential roles in marine ecosystems.

words.ex: The mastodon was a massive prehistoric creature.
words.ex_cn: 乳齿象是一种巨大的史前生物。
words.en: A mastodon is any species of extinct proboscidean in the genus Mammut, distantly related to elephants, that inhabited North and Central America during the late Miocene or late Pliocene up to their extinction at the end of the Pleistocene 10,000 to 11,000 years ago.

words.tr: n. 乳草属植物；马利筋属植物；野参类
words.ex: The monarch butterfly lays its eggs on milkweed plants.
words.ex_cn: 帝王斑蝶在乳草属植物上产卵。
words.en: A plant of the genus Asclepias, which includes about 140 species of herbaceous perennial plants, most of which are native to the Americas. They are known for their milky sap and are the primary food source for monarch butterfly larvae.

words.ex: The monkfish was caught by the local fishermen early in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 安康鱼在清晨被当地渔民捕获。
words.en: A monkfish is a type of fish known for its large head and wide mouth, often found in the North Atlantic.

words.ex: Anteaters are myrmecophagous animals that feed exclusively on ants and termites.
words.ex_cn: 食蚁兽是专门以蚂蚁和白蚁为食的食蚁动物。
words.en: Feeding on ants and termites.

words.ex: An opossum climbed into the trash can at night.
words.ex_cn: 一只负鼠在晚上爬进了垃圾桶。
words.en: A small to medium-sized marsupial native to the Americas, known for its ability to play dead when threatened.

words.ex: The osprey is known for its ability to dive into water to catch fish.
words.ex_cn: 鹗以其潜入水中捕鱼的能力而闻名。
words.en: An osprey is a large fish-eating bird of prey with a white head and underparts and dark brown wings and back.

words.ex: The garden was filled with the vibrant blue flowers of periwinkle.
words.ex_cn: 花园里开满了鲜艳的蓝色小长春花。
words.en: A periwinkle is a small plant with blue or white flowers that grows in temperate regions.

words.ex: The phalarope is a small wading bird known for its unique swimming behavior.
words.ex_cn: 矶鹞是一种以独特游泳行为著称的小型涉水鸟。
words.en: A phalarope is a small wading bird of the family Scolopacidae, characterized by its lobed toes and the unusual behavior of the females being more brightly colored than the males and taking the lead in courtship.

words.ex: Plants use sunlight for photosynthesis.
words.ex_cn: 植物利用阳光进行光合作用。
words.en: Photosynthesis is the process by which green plants and some other organisms use sunlight to synthesize foods from carbon dioxide and water.

words.tr: phrase. 植物演替；植物群落随时间推移而发生的有序、可预测的更替过程
words.ex: Plant succession is a process of ecological change.
words.ex_cn: 植物演替是一个生态变化的过程。
words.en: The process by which the structure of a biological community evolves over time. In the context of plants, it refers to the gradual and orderly process of change in plant species composition at a given site.

words.ex: The microscope revealed the intricate details of the pollen grain.
words.ex_cn: 显微镜揭示了花粉颗粒的复杂细节。
words.en: A pollen grain is a microscopic body that contains the male reproductive cells of a plant. It is produced by the anthers of seed plants and is involved in the process of pollination, where it is transferred to the female reproductive organs of a plant to fertilize it.

words.tr: phrase. 花粉剖面；花粉谱（指沉积物中不同植物花粉的比例，用于重建古植被与古气候）
words.ex: The pollen profile provides valuable information about the vegetation history of the area.
words.ex_cn: 花粉剖面图提供了该地区植被历史的宝贵信息。
words.en: A pollen profile is a record of the types and quantities of pollen found in a particular layer of sediment or soil, used to reconstruct past vegetation and climate conditions.

words.ex: The pterosaur flew high above the forest.
words.ex_cn: 翼龙在森林上方高高飞翔。
words.en: A pterosaur was a type of flying reptile that lived during the Mesozoic era.

words.ex: The reindeer walks in the snow.
words.ex_cn: 驯鹿在雪地上行走。
words.en: A reindeer is a type of deer with large horns called antlers that lives in the northern parts of Europe, Asia, and North America.

words.ex: The sandpiper runs along the beach.
words.ex_cn: 沙锥鸟在海滩上奔跑。
words.en: A sandpiper is a small wading bird with a long bill and long legs, found near water.

words.ex: The succession of rain made the ground wet.
words.ex_cn: 连续的雨水使地面变湿了。
words.en: A succession of things of the same kind is a number of them that exist or happen one after the other.

words.ex: The Tyrannosaurus rex was one of the largest land carnivores of all time.
words.ex_cn: 雷克斯暴龙是有史以来最大的陆地食肉动物之一。
words.en: A tyrannosaurus is a very large, carnivorous dinosaur that lived in the Cretaceous period.

words.tr: n. 有蹄类动物; adj. 有蹄的；像蹄子的
words.ex: The ungulate family includes horses, cows, and deer.
words.ex_cn: 有蹄类动物包括马、牛和鹿。
words.en: An ungulate is a hoofed mammal. The term encompasses a diverse group of mammals that includes horses, cows, elephants, and many others, characterized by the presence of hooves.

chapters.name: 附录二 GMAT 阅读词汇分类 医学类

words.tr: phrase. 肾上腺皮质（肾上腺的外层部分，负责分泌类固醇激素，如皮质醇和醛固酮）
words.ex: The adrenal cortex produces hormones like cortisol and aldosterone.
words.ex_cn: 肾上腺皮质产生皮质醇和醛固酮等激素。
words.en: The outer part of the adrenal gland, which produces hormones that regulate metabolism, immune system, blood pressure, and stress response.

words.tr: adj. 肾脏附近的；肾上腺的
words.ex: The adrenal glands produce hormones that help the body respond to stress.
words.ex_cn: 肾上腺分泌帮助身体应对压力的激素。
words.en: Relating to or denoting a pair of ductless glands situated above the kidneys which secrete adrenaline and other hormones.

words.tr: n. 阿莫西林；羟氨苄青霉素
words.ex: Amoxicillin is commonly prescribed for bacterial infections.
words.ex_cn: 阿莫西林常用于治疗细菌感染。
words.en: Amoxicillin is an antibiotic used to treat a number of bacterial infections. It is a moderate-spectrum, bacteriolytic, β-lactam antibiotic in the aminopenicillin family used to treat susceptible Gram-positive and Gram-negative bacteria.

words.ex: He underwent an angioplasty to clear a blocked artery.
words.ex_cn: 他接受了血管成形术以清除堵塞的动脉。
words.en: A surgical procedure to open up a blocked or narrowed blood vessel, especially a coronary artery, by inflating a small balloon within it.

words.tr: phrase. 骨髓；人体骨骼内部产生血细胞的软组织
words.ex: The doctor extracted bone marrow for testing.
words.ex_cn: 医生提取了骨髓进行检测。
words.en: The soft, fatty, vascular tissue in the interior cavities of bones that is a major site of blood cell production.

words.ex: The brain stem is responsible for essential functions like breathing and heart rate.
words.ex_cn: 脑干负责呼吸和心率等基本功能。
words.en: The brain stem is the part of the brain that connects the cerebrum with the spinal cord and controls automatic functions such as breathing, heart rate, and blood pressure.

words.tr: adj. 腹股沟淋巴结炎的
words.ex: The bubonic plague is a deadly infectious disease.
words.ex_cn: 腹股沟腺炎是一种致命的传染病。
words.en: Relating to or affected by bubonic plague, a serious disease that is spread by rats and causes swellings on the body and a high fever.

words.ex: Smoking exposes you to many carcinogens.
words.ex_cn: 吸烟会让你接触到许多致癌物。
words.en: A carcinogen is any substance, radionuclide, or radiation that is an agent directly involved in causing cancer.

words.tr: adj. 心肺的；与心肺有关的
words.ex: Cardiopulmonary resuscitation is a life-saving technique.
words.ex_cn: 心肺复苏是一种救生技术。
words.en: Relating to both the heart and the lungs.

words.ex: He runs every day to keep his cardiovascular system healthy.
words.ex_cn: 他每天跑步以保持心血管系统健康。
words.en: Relating to the heart and the blood vessels.

words.ex: The old man had caries in his jawbone.
words.ex_cn: 这位老人的颌骨患有骨疡。
words.en: Caries is the decay of bones or teeth, especially dental cavities caused by bacteria.

words.tr: n. 类胡萝卜素; [生化] 类胡萝卜色素
words.ex: Carrots contain a lot of carotenoid.
words.ex_cn: 胡萝卜含有大量的类胡萝卜素。
words.en: Carotenoids are a class of naturally occurring pigments found in plants, algae, and photosynthetic bacteria, which are responsible for the bright colors of many fruits and vegetables.

words.ex: The cartilage in his knee hurts when he runs.
words.ex_cn: 他的膝盖软骨在跑步时会疼。
words.en: Cartilage is a strong, flexible connective tissue found in various parts of the body, including the joints, the rib cage, the ear, the nose, the bronchial tubes, and the intervertebral discs. It is not as hard and rigid as bone, but it is stiffer and less flexible than muscle.

words.ex: He eats eggs but watches his cholesterol.
words.ex_cn: 他吃鸡蛋，但注意自己的胆固醇。
words.en: Cholesterol is a substance that exists in the cells of the body and in blood, which can cause heart disease if there is too much of it.

words.ex: He broke his clavicle during the soccer game.
words.ex_cn: 他在足球比赛中摔断了锁骨。
words.en: The clavicle is a bone that connects the shoulder to the body, commonly known as the collarbone.

words.tr: phrase. 冠状动脉（心脏表面为心肌供血的血管）
words.ex: The doctor recommended lifestyle changes to prevent coronary artery disease.
words.ex_cn: 医生建议改变生活方式以预防冠状动脉疾病。
words.en: The coronary artery is the artery that supplies blood to the heart muscle.

words.ex: Dengue fever is a mosquito-borne viral infection.
words.ex_cn: 登革热是一种由蚊子传播的病毒感染。
words.en: Dengue is a mosquito-borne viral infection causing a severe flu-like illness and, sometimes causing a potentially lethal complication called severe dengue.

words.ex: Encephalitis is a serious condition that requires immediate medical attention.
words.ex_cn: 脑炎是一种需要立即就医的严重疾病。
words.en: Encephalitis is an inflammation of the brain, usually caused by a viral infection.

words.ex: The doctor examined the ovarian follicles during the ultrasound.
words.ex_cn: 医生在超声检查中检查了卵巢卵泡。
words.en: A follicle is a small cavity or sac in the body, especially one in the skin that contains the root of a hair.

words.tr: phrase. 遗传编码，指DNA或RNA中核苷酸序列决定蛋白质中氨基酸序列的过程
words.ex: The study of genetic coding has revolutionized our understanding of biology.
words.ex_cn: n. 遗传编码的研究彻底改变了我们对生物学的理解。
words.en: The process by which genetic information is encoded in the DNA sequence of an organism, determining the synthesis of proteins and thus influencing the organism's traits and functions.

words.ex: The doctor checked his hemoglobin level.
words.ex_cn: 医生检查了他的血红素水平。
words.en: Hemoglobin is the protein molecule in red blood cells that carries oxygen from the lungs to the body's tissues and returns carbon dioxide from the tissues back to the lungs.

words.ex: A hemolytic reaction can occur when incompatible blood types are mixed.
words.ex_cn: 当不兼容的血型混合时，可能会发生溶血反应。
words.en: Relating to or causing the destruction of red blood cells, leading to the release of hemoglobin.

words.ex: The hospital uses a hypertherm to warm the patient's body.
words.ex_cn: 医院使用人工发热机为病人升温。
words.en: A therapeutic procedure that involves the application of high temperatures to the body for the treatment of disease.

words.ex: The hypothalamus regulates many important functions in the body.
words.ex_cn: 下丘脑调节身体中的许多重要功能。
words.en: The hypothalamus is a region of the brain that controls many bodily functions including temperature, hunger, and the release of hormones from the pituitary gland.

words.tr: n. 布洛芬，异丁苯丙酸（抗炎，镇痛药）；
words.ex: He took ibuprofen for his headache.
words.ex_cn: 他服用了布洛芬来缓解头痛。
words.en: Ibuprofen is a nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID) that is used for relieving pain, reducing fever, and decreasing inflammation.

words.ex: Indomethacin is often prescribed for acute gout attacks.
words.ex_cn: 消炎痛常用于治疗急性痛风发作。
words.en: Indomethacin is a nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID) used to reduce pain, swelling, and joint stiffness caused by arthritis, gout, and other conditions.

words.tr: n. [医] 接种；接木；接插芽
words.ex: The child received inoculation against measles last week.
words.ex_cn: 孩子上周接种了麻疹疫苗。
words.en: The act of introducing a vaccine into the body to produce immunity to a specific disease.

words.ex: He takes insulin to control his blood sugar.
words.ex_cn: 他注射胰岛素来控制血糖。
words.en: A hormone produced in the pancreas by the islets of Langerhans, which regulates the amount of glucose in the blood. The lack of insulin causes a form of diabetes.

words.tr: phrase. 体内起搏器；植入式心脏起搏器
words.ex: The patient received an internal pacemaker to regulate their heartbeat.
words.ex_cn: 患者接受了体内埋入式起搏器以调节他们的心跳。
words.en: An internal pacemaker is a small device placed inside the body to help control abnormal heart rhythms.

words.ex: Keratitis can be caused by various infections and injuries.
words.ex_cn: 角膜炎可以由各种感染和损伤引起。
words.en: Keratitis is an inflammation of the cornea, the clear, dome-shaped surface that covers the front of the eye. It can cause pain, impaired eyesight, and sensitivity to light.

words.ex: He has leukemia and takes medicine every day.
words.ex_cn: 他患有白血病，每天吃药。
words.en: Leukemia is a type of cancer that affects the blood and bone marrow, characterized by an abnormal increase in white blood cells.

words.tr: n. 欧亚甘草；甘草汁；甘草糖（等于 liquorice）
words.ex: She chewed on a piece of licorice to soothe her throat.
words.ex_cn: 她嚼了一块甘草糖来舒缓喉咙。
words.en: Licorice is a plant whose root is used in medicine and to flavor sweets and drinks.

words.tr: n. 莱姆关节炎；欧滨麦（植物）
words.ex: Lyme disease is caused by bacteria transmitted through tick bites.
words.ex_cn: 莱姆病是由通过蜱虫叮咬传播的细菌引起的。
words.en: Lyme disease is an infectious disease caused by the bacterium Borrelia burgdorferi and transmitted to humans through the bite of infected black-legged ticks.

words.ex: The lymph helps fight infections in the body.
words.ex_cn: 淋巴有助于抵抗身体中的感染。
words.en: Lymph is a clear fluid that is derived from blood plasma and contains white blood cells, especially lymphocytes.

words.ex: Lymphocytes are a type of white blood cell that plays a key role in the immune system.
words.ex_cn: 淋巴细胞是一种白血细胞，在免疫系统中起着关键作用。
words.en: A lymphocyte is a type of white blood cell that is part of the immune system. Lymphocytes include natural killer cells, T cells, and B cells. They are the main type of cell found in lymph, which prompted the name 'lymphocyte'.

words.ex: He did an analysis of the data.
words.ex_cn: 他对数据进行了分析。
words.en: Analysis is the process of considering something carefully or using statistical methods in order to understand it or explain it.

words.ex: He takes melatonin to sleep better at night.
words.ex_cn: 他服用褪黑素以更好地入睡。
words.en: A hormone secreted by the pineal gland that regulates sleep and wakefulness.

words.ex: Mesothelioma is a rare form of cancer usually caused by asbestos exposure.
words.ex_cn: 间皮瘤是一种罕见的癌症，通常由石棉暴露引起。
words.en: A type of cancer that occurs in the thin layer of tissue that covers the majority of your internal organs (mesothelium).

words.ex: He has a migraine every Monday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周一都偏头痛。
words.en: A migraine is a severe, often painful headache that can be accompanied by nausea, vomiting, and sensitivity to light and sound.

words.ex: The neuron sends signals to the brain.
words.ex_cn: 神经元向大脑发送信号。
words.en: A neuron is a cell that is specialized to conduct nerve impulses.

words.tr: n. 神经递质；神经传导物质
words.ex: The release of neurotransmitters in the brain affects mood and behavior.
words.ex_cn: 大脑中神经递质的释放会影响情绪和行为。
words.en: A neurotransmitter is a chemical substance that is released at the end of a nerve fiber by the arrival of a nerve impulse and, by diffusing across the synapse or junction, effects the transfer of the impulse to another nerve fiber, a muscle fiber, or some other structure.

words.tr: n. 奴佛卡因（一种麻醉药）
words.ex: The dentist used novocaine to numb the area before starting the procedure.
words.ex_cn: 牙医在开始手术前使用奴佛卡因来麻醉该区域。
words.en: Novocaine is a local anesthetic drug used primarily to reduce pain during dental procedures.

words.ex: Osteoarthritis is a common joint disorder that primarily affects cartilage.
words.ex_cn: 骨关节炎是一种常见的关节疾病，主要影响软骨。
words.en: A type of arthritis that occurs when flexible tissue at the ends of bones wears down.

words.tr: n. [皮肤] 糙皮病；玉蜀黍疹
words.ex: Pellagra is a disease caused by a deficiency of niacin.
words.ex_cn: 糙皮病是由于烟酸缺乏引起的疾病。
words.en: Pellagra is a disease caused by a lack of niacin (vitamin B3) in the diet, characterized by skin inflammation, diarrhea, and mental disturbance.

words.ex: The doctor examined her pelvic area.
words.ex_cn: 医生检查了她的骨盆区域。
words.en: Relating to the pelvis.

words.tr: n. 噬菌作用；吞噬作用
words.ex: Phagocytosis is a key process in the immune system.
words.ex_cn: 吞噬作用是免疫系统中的一个关键过程。
words.en: The process by which a cell engulfs and digests particles, such as bacteria or dead tissue cells.

words.ex: The pituitary controls growth in the body.
words.ex_cn: 脑垂体控制身体的生长。
words.en: The pituitary is a small gland at the base of the brain that produces hormones affecting growth and the functions of other glands in the body.

words.ex: The pituitary gland controls many body functions.
words.ex_cn: 垂体腺控制许多身体功能。
words.en: The pituitary gland is a small, pea-shaped gland located at the base of the brain, which produces hormones that regulate many functions of the body, including growth, blood pressure, and reproduction.

words.tr: n. 脊髓灰质炎；小儿麻痹症
words.ex: He had poliomyelitis as a child.
words.ex_cn: 他小时候得了脊髓灰质炎。
words.en: Poliomyelitis, often called polio, is a highly infectious disease caused by a virus that invades the nervous system and can lead to paralysis.

words.ex: Prostaglandins are involved in various physiological processes.
words.ex_cn: 前列腺素参与了各种生理过程。
words.en: Prostaglandins are a group of physiologically active lipid compounds having diverse hormone-like effects in animals.

words.ex: He visited the doctor for a prostate check.
words.ex_cn: 他去看医生做前列腺检查。
words.en: The prostate is a gland in the male reproductive system that is located just below the bladder and in front of the rectum. It surrounds the urethra, the tube through which urine and semen exit the body.

words.ex: She learned to use a prosthetic hand after her accident.
words.ex_cn: 她在事故后学会了使用假手。
words.en: A prosthetic hand is an artificial device that replaces a missing hand, which may be lost through trauma, disease, or congenital conditions.

words.tr: adj. 类风湿的；患风湿性关节炎的
words.ex: He has rheumatoid arthritis in his hands.
words.ex_cn: 他双手患有类风湿性关节炎。
words.en: Rheumatoid refers to something that is related to or resembling rheumatism, especially rheumatoid arthritis, a chronic autoimmune disease characterized by inflammation of the joints.

words.ex: The common cold is often caused by a rhinovirus.
words.ex_cn: 普通感冒通常由鼻病毒引起。
words.en: A rhinovirus is any of a group of picornaviruses including those that cause some forms of the common cold in humans.

words.tr: n. 番红花粉；藏红花粉；
words.ex: She added a pinch of saffron to the rice.
words.ex_cn: 她往米饭里加了一小撮番红花粉。
words.en: Saffron is a very expensive spice that is used to color and flavor food. It is made from the dried stigmas of the saffron crocus.

words.tr: n. 血吸虫病；裂体吸虫病；
words.ex: He got schistosomiasis from swimming in a dirty river.
words.ex_cn: 他因在脏河里游泳而感染了血吸虫病。
words.en: Schistosomiasis is a disease caused by infection with freshwater parasitic worms in certain tropical and subtropical countries.

words.ex: Serotonin helps regulate mood and sleep.
words.ex_cn: 5-羟色胺有助于调节情绪和睡眠。
words.en: A compound present in blood platelets and serum that constricts the blood vessels and acts as a neurotransmitter.

words.ex: Chronic sinusitis can cause persistent headaches and nasal congestion.
words.ex_cn: 慢性窦炎会导致持续的头痛和鼻塞。
words.en: Sinusitis is a condition in which the sinuses become inflamed or infected.

words.ex: The accident damaged his spinal cord.
words.ex_cn: 事故损伤了他的脊髓。
words.en: The spinal cord is a long, thin, tubular structure made up of nervous tissue, which extends from the medulla oblongata in the brainstem to the lumbar region of the vertebral column. It encloses the central canal of the spinal cord, which contains cerebrospinal fluid.

words.tr: phrase. 链球菌性咽喉炎（由A组链球菌引起的咽喉感染）
words.ex: He has strep throat and can't swallow.
words.ex_cn: 他得了链球菌性咽炎，吞咽困难。
words.en: Strep throat is an infection of the throat and tonsils caused by a type of bacteria called group A Streptococcus.

words.ex: The doctor checked his thyroid gland.
words.ex_cn: 医生检查了他的甲状腺。
words.en: The thyroid gland is a large ductless gland in the neck that secretes hormones regulating growth and development through the rate of metabolism.

words.tr: n. 金-石英；一种含有金颗粒的石英矿石
words.ex: Gold-quartz veins are often found in areas with significant gold deposits.
words.ex_cn: 金-石英矿脉通常出现在金矿储量丰富的地区。
words.en: A type of quartz that contains gold particles.

words.tr: n. 凉拌卷心菜（等于 coldslaw）
words.ex: He ate coleslaw with his burger.
words.ex_cn: 他吃汉堡时配了卷心菜沙拉。
words.en: Coleslaw is a salad consisting of shredded raw cabbage and sometimes shredded carrots, dressed with mayonnaise or a vinaigrette.

chapters.name: 附录三 GMAT 常考短语及词组

words.tr: phrase. 航拍图像；空中影像
words.ex: The drone captured an aerial image of the landscape.
words.ex_cn: 无人机拍摄了地形的空中图像。
words.en: An aerial image is a photograph taken from an aircraft or satellite in flight, showing a view of the earth or other objects from above.

words.tr: phrase. 气体包络；空气外壳（指围绕物体的空气层，如飞行器周围的气流区域）
words.ex: The air envelope is crucial for maintaining the temperature inside the kiln.
words.ex_cn: 二次风对于保持窑内温度至关重要。
words.en: A protective layer of air surrounding the Earth, essential for life and climate regulation.

words.tr: phrase. 更加；愈发（用于加强比较或强调程度）
words.ex: He was tired, but all the more determined to finish the race.
words.ex_cn: 他很累，但更加决心完成比赛。
words.en: You use 'all the more' to emphasize that something is even more the case than usual.

words.tr: phrase. 遭遇战；意外发生的冲突或行动
words.ex: The soldiers were prepared for an encounter action.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们为遭遇战做好了准备。
words.en: A direct confrontation or conflict between opposing forces or individuals.

words.tr: phrase. 反垄断法；旨在防止企业垄断市场、促进公平竞争的法律
words.ex: The company broke antitrust law by controlling prices.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司通过控制价格违反了反垄断法。
words.en: Legislation enacted to prevent monopolies and promote competition in the marketplace.

words.ex: Workers stand on the assembly line to put parts together.
words.ex_cn: 工人们站在装配线上组装零件。
words.en: An assembly line is a manufacturing process in which parts are added to a product in a sequential manner to create a finished product.

words.tr: adj. 尚未开发的；未被利用的
words.ex: The company is looking for as-yet-unexploited markets to expand into.
words.ex_cn: 该公司正在寻找尚未开发的市场以进行扩张。
words.en: Something that is as-yet-unexploited has not been used or taken advantage of up to the present time.

words.ex: He is at best a beginner in cooking.
words.ex_cn: 他在烹饪方面最多是个初学者。
words.en: At best is used to indicate the most positive or optimistic scenario or outcome, often implying that the actual situation may be worse.

words.tr:
n. 问题；重要议题；发行（物）；
v. 发行；
words.ex: The main issue is lack of money.
words.ex_cn: 主要问题是缺乏资金。
words.en: An issue is an important subject or problem that people are talking about or arguing about.

words.tr: 短语. 意见不一致的；处于冲突状态的；互相矛盾的
words.ex: The two parties have been at odds over the new policy.
words.ex_cn: 这两个政党在新政策上一直存在分歧。
words.en: If someone is at odds with someone else, or if two people are at odds, they disagree about something.

words.ex: He solved the problem at one stroke.
words.ex_cn: 他一下子就解决了问题。
words.en: If something happens at one stroke, it happens suddenly and completely, often as the result of a single action.

words.tr: phrase. 在危险中；处于成败关头
words.ex: His job is at stake if he is late again.
words.ex_cn: 如果他再迟到，他的工作就保不住了。
words.en: If something is at stake, it is being risked and might be lost or damaged if something goes wrong.

words.tr: phrase. v.平均下来：在一段时间内产生一个均衡的结果。; 总体上来说：总体来看，有时你赢，有时你输，最终一切都会...
words.ex: The prices average out to $10 each.
words.ex_cn: 这些价格平均下来是每件10美元。
words.en: To calculate the mean of numbers or amounts, or to reach a typical level or amount after various increases and decreases.

words.ex: I found a great bargain at the market.
words.ex_cn: 我在市场上找到了一件便宜货。
words.en: A bargain is an agreement between two people or groups in which each promises to do something in exchange for something else. It can also refer to something bought or offered for sale much more cheaply than is usual or expected.

words.tr: 短语. 处于不利地位；处于劣势
words.ex: He is at a disadvantage because he doesn't speak English well.
words.ex_cn: 他因为英语说得不好而处于劣势。
words.en: To be in a situation where one is less likely to succeed than others because of a lack of resources, support, or favorable conditions.

words.tr: phrase. 对…保持警惕的；对…心存怀疑的
words.ex: You should be leery of strangers offering help.
words.ex_cn: 你应该对提供帮助的陌生人保持警惕。
words.en: To be cautious or wary of someone or something, often because you suspect that they may be dangerous or harmful.

words.ex: The glue will bind to the paper tightly.
words.ex_cn: 胶水会紧紧地粘在纸上。
words.en: To associate or link something closely to something else, often in a way that is difficult to separate.

words.ex: The star fell into a black hole.
words.ex_cn: 这颗恒星落入了一个黑洞。
words.en: A black hole is a region of space having a gravitational field so intense that no matter or radiation can escape.

words.tr: phrase. 盲点：视网膜后部进入眼球的视神经的小圆形区域，缺乏视杆细胞和视锥细胞，对光不敏感-也称为视盘，参见眼...
words.ex: The blind spot is where the optic nerve enters the eye and you can't see light.
words.ex_cn: 盲点是视神经进入眼睛的地方，那里看不到光。
words.en: An area that you are unable to see, especially the part of the road you cannot see when you are driving a car.

words.tr: phrase. 教育委员会；教育局
words.ex: The board of education has decided to implement new teaching methods.
words.ex_cn: 教育委员会决定实施新的教学方法。
words.en: A board of education is a group of people who are in charge of all the public schools in a particular area.

words.ex: He is a bona fide expert in history.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位真正的历史专家。
words.en: Made in good faith without fraud or deceit.

words.tr: phrase. 诚意；诚实；真实意图（拉丁语，常用于法律语境中）
words.ex: The document was submitted as evidence of his bona fides.
words.ex_cn: 这份文件被提交作为他真诚意愿的证据。
words.en: The quality of being genuine or real; sincerity and honesty.

words.tr: phrase. 缓冲库存；缓冲存货（用于稳定市场价格的储备物资）
words.ex: The buffer stock mechanism is designed to stabilize commodity prices by buying when prices are low and selling when they are high.
words.ex_cn: 缓冲库存机制旨在通过在价格低时买入，在价格高时卖出，来稳定商品价格。
words.en: A reserve supply of a commodity or product that is used to offset fluctuations in availability and price.

words.ex: The business world is highly competitive and constantly evolving.
words.ex_cn: 商业世界竞争激烈，且不断变化。
words.en: The business world refers to the global marketplace of buying, selling, and other financial activities conducted by businesses.

words.ex: The factory makes cheese, and whey is a by-product.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂生产奶酪，乳清是副产品。
words.en: A by-product is something that is produced as a result of making something else, or something unexpected that happens as a result of something.

words.tr: phrase. 呼吁；号召；要求；接（人）
words.ex: The situation calls for immediate action.
words.ex_cn: 这种情况需要立即采取行动。
words.en: If you call for something, you demand that it should happen.

words.tr: phrase. 取消；转移；叫走；依次叫名
words.ex: They decided to call off the meeting because of the storm.
words.ex_cn: 他们因为风暴决定取消会议。
words.en: To cancel or abandon something that was planned.

words.tr: 短语动词. 利用对手的错误
words.ex: In the chess game, he managed to capitalize on the opponent's mistake and won.
words.ex_cn: v. 在象棋比赛中，他成功地利用了对手的错误并获胜。
words.en: To take advantage of the opponent's error to benefit oneself.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 利用（机会、优势等）；从……中获利
words.ex: They decided to capitalize on the success of their previous album.
words.ex_cn: 他们决定利用上一张专辑的成功。
words.en: To capitalize on something means to use a situation or opportunity to gain an advantage for yourself.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 利用…获利；从…中赚取利益
words.ex: He tried to cash in on the new trend.
words.ex_cn: 他试图利用这个新趋势赚钱。
words.en: To take advantage of an opportunity in order to make money or gain something.

words.tr: phrase. 以…为中心；重点在于…
words.ex: The lesson centers on basic math skills.
words.ex_cn: 这节课的重点是基本数学技能。
words.en: To have something as the main subject of attention or interest.

words.tr: phrase. 办公用品；文书用品（指办公室日常使用的文具、纸张、笔墨等）
words.ex: The office manager ordered a new batch of clerical supplies.
words.ex_cn: 办公室经理订购了一批新的文具。
words.en: Clerical supplies refer to the materials and equipment used in offices, such as paper, pens, and other stationery items, necessary for the completion of clerical tasks.

words.tr: phrase. 办公室文职工作；文书工作
words.ex: He does clerical work in an office.
words.ex_cn: 他在办公室做文书工作。
words.en: Clerical work refers to the routine tasks and duties performed in an office setting, such as typing, filing, and handling correspondence.

words.ex: He still clings to his old beliefs.
words.ex_cn: 他仍然坚持自己的旧信念。
words.en: To hold on tightly to something or someone, either physically or emotionally, often because of fear, love, or a strong desire.

words.tr: phrase. 闭路电视；一种只能在有限范围内接收信号的电视系统，常用于监控
words.ex: The security guard monitored the area using closed-circuit television.
words.ex_cn: 保安使用闭路电视监控该区域。
words.en: A television system in which signals are transmitted over a closed circuit, typically used for security or surveillance purposes.

words.tr: phrase. 集体意识；群体共同的思想、信念或价值观
words.ex: The collective consciousness of the group led to a unified decision.
words.ex_cn: 群体的集体意识导致了一个统一的决定。
words.en: The collective consciousness refers to the set of shared beliefs, ideas, and moral attitudes which operate as a unifying force within society.

words.tr: phrase. 普通法（英国和美国等国家的法律体系，基于法院判例而非成文法）
words.ex: In many countries, common law is used alongside civil law.
words.ex_cn: 在许多国家，普通法与民法并行使用。
words.en: The common law is the body of law derived from judicial decisions of courts and similar tribunals, rather than from statutes.

words.ex: The company gained a competitive edge by lowering costs.
words.ex_cn: 公司通过降低成本获得了竞争优势。
words.en: A competitive edge is an advantage that a company or country has that enables it to be more successful than its competitors.

words.ex: The bank pays compound interest every year.
words.ex_cn: 银行每年支付复利。
words.en: Compound interest is interest calculated on the initial principal and also on the accumulated interest of previous periods of a deposit or loan.

words.ex: He buys consumer goods every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周都购买消费品。
words.en: Goods that are bought and used by consumers, rather than by manufacturers for producing other goods.

words.tr: phrase. 海关服务；负责监管进出口货物、征收关税及防止走私的政府服务部门
words.ex: The customs service checked his luggage at the airport.
words.ex_cn: 海关人员在机场检查了他的行李。
words.en: The department or agency responsible for collecting duties and controlling the flow of goods into and out of a country.

words.tr: phrase. 夏令时；日光节约时间（指在夏季将时钟调快一小时以充分利用日光）
words.ex: Daylight saving time is observed in many countries to maximize daylight hours.
words.ex_cn: 许多国家实行夏令时以最大化日光时间。
words.en: Daylight saving time is the period during which the time is adjusted forward by one hour from the standard time, usually to make better use of daylight in the evenings.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 深入探究；深入研究
words.ex: He delves into ancient history books.
words.ex_cn: 他深入钻研古代历史书籍。
words.en: To delve into something means to try to discover new information about it or to examine it in detail.

words.tr: phrase. 数字音频磁带；一种用于录制和存储数字音频信号的磁带格式
words.ex: The studio used digital audiotape to record the live performance.
words.ex_cn: 工作室使用数字录音带来录制现场表演。
words.en: A type of magnetic tape used for recording sound in a digital format.

words.tr: phrase. 过分喜爱；溺爱；对……非常疼爱
words.ex: She likes to dote on her grandchildren.
words.ex_cn: 她喜欢溺爱她的孙子孙女。
words.en: To show excessive love or fondness for someone, often to the point of spoiling them.

words.tr: phrase. 收（债务）；引诱；（天色）接近黄昏；紧缩（开支）；（车）到站；用...绘画；吸入（气体）；缩短；拉回（网）
words.ex: The bank will draw in the loan next month.
words.ex_cn: 银行下个月将收回贷款。
words.en: To attract or entice someone or something into a place or situation.

words.ex: He draws on his old experience to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他利用自己的旧经验来解决这个问题。
words.en: To make use of something, especially a resource or skill, that one has available.

words.tr: phrase. v. 逐渐接近（某段时间或事件）
words.ex: The holiday is drawing to an end.
words.ex_cn: 假期正逐渐接近尾声。
words.en: To attract someone or something to a particular place or person.

words.tr: phrase. 地震震源；地震发生的起始点，通常位于地下某一深度，地震能量由此处向四周传播
words.ex: The earthquake focus was located several kilometers below the surface.
words.ex_cn: 地震震源位于地表以下数公里处。
words.en: The point within the Earth's crust where an earthquake originates, releasing seismic energy.

words.tr: phrase. 生态系统；指生物与其环境相互作用的自然系统
words.ex: The study of ecological systems helps us understand the balance of nature.
words.ex_cn: 生态系统的研究帮助我们理解自然的平衡。
words.en: Ecological systems refer to the complex network of interactions among organisms and their environment, functioning as a unit.

words.tr: phrase. 情景记忆；指对个人亲身经历过的特定事件或情景的记忆，通常包含时间、地点和相关情感等细节
words.ex: He remembers his first day of school as episodic memory.
words.ex_cn: 他把第一天上学的记忆作为情景记忆。
words.en: Episodic memory is the memory of autobiographical events (times, places, associated emotions, and other contextual who, what, when, where, why knowledge) that can be explicitly stated or conjured. It is the collection of past personal experiences that occurred at a particular time and place.

words.tr: phrase. 陷入常规；变得单调乏味；进入一成不变的状态
words.ex: He felt his daily routine fall into a rut.
words.ex_cn: 他感觉自己的日常生活陷入了一成不变的境地。
words.en: To become stuck in a monotonous or unvarying routine or pattern of behavior.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 属于…范畴；被归入；受…管辖
words.ex: The new regulation will fall under the existing laws.
words.ex_cn: 新法规将归入现行法律。
words.en: To be classified or included within a particular category or group.

words.tr: phrase. v. 度过难关；勉强应付；勉强维持生活
words.ex: He gets by with little money.
words.ex_cn: 他靠很少的钱维持生活。
words.en: To manage to live or do a particular thing using the money, knowledge, equipment, etc. that you have.

words.tr: phrase. 通过；（电话）打通；度过；做完；用完
words.ex: He got through the exam with help from his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他在朋友的帮助下通过了考试。
words.en: To succeed in reaching a place or a stage in a process, or to make someone understand or accept something.

words.ex: Poor hygiene can give rise to infections.
words.ex_cn: 不良的卫生习惯可能导致感染。
words.en: To cause something to happen or exist.

words.ex: The old rules give way to new ones.
words.ex_cn: 旧规则让位于新规则。
words.en: If something gives way to something else, it is replaced by it.

words.tr: phrase. 政府干预；指政府为影响经济或社会活动而采取的措施或行动
words.ex: The government intervention helped stabilize the economy.
words.ex_cn: 政府干预帮助稳定了经济。
words.en: Government intervention refers to the actions taken by a government to affect the economy or society, often to correct market failures or to achieve a social or economic objective.

words.tr: phrase. 政府服务；公共服务
words.ex: The government service sector is expanding to meet the needs of an increasing population.
words.ex_cn: 政府服务部门正在扩展，以满足日益增长的人口需求。
words.en: The work or duties performed by the government for the public.

words.tr: phrase. v. 传递；交给（某人）
words.ex: Please hand on the book to your friend.
words.ex_cn: 请把书递给你的朋友。
words.en: To pass something to someone else, especially so that they can take over a responsibility or duty.

words.tr: phrase. 先机；领先的优势；提前开始的机会
words.ex: She gave her son a head start in the race by letting him start a few seconds earlier.
words.ex_cn: 她让儿子在比赛中提前几秒开始，给了他一个领先优势。
words.en: An advantage that someone has over other people in something such as a competition or race.

words.tr: phrase. 等级制度的管理；层级式管理
words.ex: Hierarchical management often results in a clear chain of command.
words.ex_cn: 分层管理通常会产生一个清晰的指挥链。
words.en: A system of management in which authority and responsibility are arranged in a series of levels from the highest to the lowest.

words.tr: phrase. 热门节目；受欢迎的演出
words.ex: The new drama became a hit show overnight.
words.ex_cn: 这部新剧一夜之间成为了热门节目。
words.en: A hit show refers to a television program or theatrical performance that has achieved great popularity and success.

words.tr: phrase. 住房开工；指新住宅建设项目的启动数量，通常用作衡量房地产市场活跃程度的指标
words.ex: The government announced an increase in housing starts to stimulate the economy.
words.ex_cn: 政府宣布增加房屋开工以刺激经济。
words.en: The number of new residential construction projects that have begun during any particular month.

words.tr: n. （非正式）矮胖子；被推翻后无法复位的人（或物）
words.ex: Humpty-Dumpty sat on the wall and fell down.
words.ex_cn: 矮胖子坐在墙上，然后摔了下来。
words.en: A term used to describe someone or something that is short and round, or a situation that has failed and cannot be fixed.

words.ex: The ice age covered big parts of the Earth with ice.
words.ex_cn: 冰河时代使地球的大部分地区被冰覆盖。
words.en: A period in the Earth's history when ice sheets covered large areas of the planet's surface.

words.ex: The Greenland ice sheet is one of the largest in the world.
words.ex_cn: 格陵兰冰盖是世界上最大的冰盖之一。
words.en: A large mass of ice covering an extensive area of land, especially in polar regions.

words.tr: n. 减缓；宽慰；解脱；救济；
words.ex: The medicine brought relief to his pain.
words.ex_cn: 这种药缓解了他的疼痛。
words.en: Relief is a feeling of reassurance and relaxation following release from anxiety or distress.

words.tr: phrase. 一致地；齐心地；合作地；在现场音乐会上
words.ex: They worked in concert to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他们齐心协力解决了问题。
words.en: If a number of people do something in concert, they do it together.

words.tr: phrase. 盛开；处于全盛时期；繁花似锦
words.ex: The garden is in full bloom in spring.
words.ex_cn: phrase. 春天，花园里的花都盛开了。
words.en: If a plant or tree is in full bloom, it has all its flowers fully open.

words.tr: phrase. 以实物（而非金钱）；以同样方式；回以同类事物
words.ex: She repaid his help in kind by offering her assistance when he needed it.
words.ex_cn: 她以同样的方式回报了他的帮助，在他需要时提供了帮助。
words.en: If you do something in kind, you do the same thing to someone that they have just done to you.

words.ex: He changed his plan in light of the new weather forecast.
words.ex_cn: 根据新的天气预报，他改变了计划。
words.en: Used to introduce a fact or situation that is the reason for a particular action or decision.

words.tr: phrase. 对某人有利；支持某人；以某人为受益人
words.ex: The evidence is in his favor.
words.ex_cn: 证据对他有利。
words.en: If a decision, judgment, or ruling is in someone's favor, it is advantageous to them or supports their case.

words.tr: phrase. 在某种程度上，就某种程度而言
words.ex: He will help you insofar as he can.
words.ex_cn: 他能帮多少就帮多少。
words.en: to the extent or degree that

words.tr: phrase. 契约佣工；签订契约的仆人（通常指在固定年限内以劳动偿还旅费或债务的人）
words.ex: Many immigrants came to America as indentured servants in the 17th and 18th centuries.
words.ex_cn: 许多移民在17世纪和18世纪以契约仆人的身份来到美国。
words.en: A person who is bound by a contract to work for another for a specified period of time, especially in return for passage to a new country or training in a trade.

words.tr: phrase. 内部变量；在程序或函数内部定义、仅在其作用域内可访问的变量
words.ex: The programmer used an internal variable to store temporary data.
words.ex_cn: 程序员使用内部变量来存储临时数据。
words.en: An internal variable is a variable that is defined within a function or a block and is not accessible from outside that function or block.

words.tr: phrase. 美国种族隔离制度；吉姆·克劳法（指19世纪末至20世纪中期美国南部针对非裔美国人的种族歧视法律体系）
words.ex: The Jim Crow laws enforced racial segregation in the southern United States.
words.ex_cn: 吉姆·克劳法在美国南部强制实行种族隔离。
words.en: Jim Crow refers to the laws and customs that enforced racial segregation in the Southern United States until the mid-20th century.

words.ex: The labor contractor was responsible for hiring workers for the construction site.
words.ex_cn: 劳工承包商负责为建筑工地招聘工人。
words.en: A labor contractor is a person or company that is responsible for hiring and managing workers, especially for temporary or seasonal work.

words.tr: phrase. 自由放任资本主义；一种政府极少干预市场、强调自由竞争和私有产权的经济体制
words.ex: He believes in laissez-faire capitalism and wants minimal government control.
words.ex_cn: 他相信自由放任的资本主义，希望政府干预最少。
words.en: An economic system in which transactions between private parties are free from government intervention such as regulation, privileges, tariffs, and subsidies.

words.ex: The company will lay off 50 workers next month.
words.ex_cn: 公司下个月将裁员50人。
words.en: To terminate the employment of a worker or workers, especially temporarily, because there is not enough work for them to do.

words.tr: phrase. 系列讲座；系列演讲
words.ex: The university offers a popular lecture series on contemporary art.
words.ex_cn: 这所大学提供了一个关于当代艺术的热门讲座系列。
words.en: A sequence of lectures on a particular subject, delivered as part of a course or program.

words.tr: phrase. 行业；职业；工作领域
words.ex: She has been in the same line of work for over 20 years.
words.ex_cn: 她在同一个行业已经工作了20多年。
words.en: A line of work is a particular kind of job or profession.

words.tr: phrase. 标价；定价；目录价格；官方零售价
words.ex: The list price of the book is $20.
words.ex_cn: 这本书的标价是20美元。
words.en: The original, advertised selling price of an item before any discounts or negotiations.

words.tr: phrase. 现场演出；现场表演；直播节目
words.ex: The band gave an electrifying live show last night.
words.ex_cn: 昨晚乐队进行了一场令人振奋的现场表演。
words.en: A live show is a performance, such as a concert or play, that is performed in front of an audience and broadcasted in real-time.

words.tr: phrase. 锁定；固定；使陷入（某种状态或协议中而无法轻易改变）
words.ex: They lock into the same routine every day.
words.ex_cn: 他们每天都会陷入相同的日常程序。
words.en: To commit to something in a way that makes it difficult to change or stop.

words.ex: You must look to your health before it's too late.
words.ex_cn: 你必须注意你的健康，趁还来得及。
words.en: To expect or depend on someone or something to do something or provide something.

words.tr: phrase. 体谅；考虑到；为…留余地；酌情扣除
words.ex: We should make allowances for his youth and inexperience.
words.ex_cn: 我们应该体谅他的年轻和缺乏经验。
words.en: To consider or make concessions for someone's circumstances or limitations.

words.tr: phrase. 使收支相抵；勉强维持生计；量入为出
words.ex: He works two jobs to make ends meet.
words.ex_cn: 他做两份工作来维持生计。
words.en: To have enough money to pay for the things that you need.

words.tr: phrase. 使收支相抵；勉强维持生计；量入为出
words.ex: He works two jobs to make both ends meet.
words.ex_cn: 他做两份工作来维持收支平衡。
words.en: To have enough money to pay for the things that you need.

words.tr: n. 标低价，[物价] 减价
words.ex: The store gave a markdown on all summer clothes.
words.ex_cn: 商店对所有夏季服装进行了减价。
words.en: A reduction in the price of something, especially in a retail context.

words.tr: n. 加价；毛利；涨价幅度
words.ex: The store adds a 20% markup to the cost of goods.
words.ex_cn: 商店在商品成本上加了20%的利润。
words.en: The amount added to the cost price of goods to cover overhead and profit.

words.ex: She took maternity leave after her baby was born.
words.ex_cn: 她生完孩子后休了产假。
words.en: A period of absence from work granted to a mother before and after the birth of her child.

words.tr: phrase. 兵役；军事服役；服兵役期间
words.ex: He completed his military service last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年完成了兵役。
words.en: Military service refers to the period of time that a person spends serving in the armed forces.

words.tr: phrase. 镜像；映像；完全对应的人或物；翻版
words.ex: The left hand is a mirror image of the right hand.
words.ex_cn: 左手是右手的镜像。
words.en: An image that is identical in form to another but has the structure reversed, as in a mirror.

words.ex: More often than not, he walks to school.
words.ex_cn: 大多数情况下，他走路去上学。
words.en: If you say that something happens more often than not, you mean that it happens more than half the time.

words.tr: phrase. 比以往任何时候都更；更加；愈发
words.ex: He is working harder more than ever before.
words.ex_cn: 他比以往任何时候都更加努力工作。
words.en: To a greater extent or degree than ever before.

words.tr: phrase. 与…同等水平；与…不相上下；与…价值或地位相等
words.ex: The two players are on a par in terms of skill.
words.ex_cn: 这两名选手的技能水平相当。
words.en: equal in importance or quality to someone or something else

words.ex: He spoke on behalf of his sister.
words.ex_cn: 他代表他的妹妹发言。
words.en: If you do something on behalf of someone, you do it as their representative or in their interest.

words.tr: phrase. 以某人的名誉担保；凭人格保证
words.ex: He promised on his word of honor to help me.
words.ex_cn: 他以荣誉保证会帮我。
words.en: A promise made by someone who is trusted to keep their word, often implying a moral obligation to fulfill the promise.

words.tr: phrase. 违者处死；以死刑相威胁；违令者格杀勿论
words.ex: You are forbidden to enter this area on pain of death.
words.ex_cn: 你被禁止进入这个区域，否则将以死相逼。
words.en: Under the threat of being killed.

words.tr: phrase. 公开市场；自由市场；开放的市场经济
words.ex: The government buys food in the open market.
words.ex_cn: 政府在公开市场上购买粮食。
words.en: An open market is a market that is accessible to all potential buyers and sellers, with no restrictions on who can participate.

words.tr: phrase. 除了…以外；不包括；绝不是
words.ex: He eats vegetables other than potatoes.
words.ex_cn: 他吃蔬菜，但不吃土豆。
words.en: You use 'other than' after a negative statement to say that the person, item, or thing that follows is the only exception to the statement.

words.tr: n. (Japanese) 親分子分 (literally 'parent-child'), a term used in Japanese organized crime (yakuza) to describe the relationship between a senior and junior member.
words.ex: In the yakuza hierarchy, the oyabun-kobun relationship is strictly observed.
words.ex_cn: 在山口组的等级制度中，亲分子分关系是严格遵守的。
words.en: A traditional Japanese hierarchical relationship between a mentor (oyabun) and a protégé (kobun), often found within the yakuza.

words.tr: phrase. 分手；分道扬镳；终止合作；分别
words.ex: After years of partnership, they decided to part company due to irreconcilable differences.
words.ex_cn: 经过多年的合作，他们因无法调和的分歧决定分道扬镳。
words.en: To separate or go in different directions, especially after a period of association or partnership.

words.ex: Don't pass up this opportunity; it may never come again.
words.ex_cn: 不要错过这个机会；它可能再也不会来了。
words.en: To choose not to take advantage of an opportunity.

words.tr: adj. 小气的，吝啬的; n. 小气; v. 对……吝啬（penny-pinch 的 ing 形式...
words.ex: His penny-pinching ways made him unpopular among his colleagues.
words.ex_cn: 他吝啬的习惯使得他在同事中不受欢迎。
words.en: Penny-pinching is used to describe someone who is unwilling to spend money, often to an excessive degree.

words.tr: phrase. 首要位置；最显眼或最重要的地位
words.ex: The painting occupies the pride of place in the living room.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画占据了客厅中最显眼的位置。
words.en: If something takes pride of place, it is in the best or most important position.

words.tr: phrase. 黄金时段收视率；指电视台在晚间最受欢迎时段所获得的观众数量指标
words.ex: The show achieved high prime-time ratings.
words.ex_cn: 该节目获得了很高的黄金时段收视率。
words.en: The viewership statistics for television programs broadcast during the most popular and competitive evening hours.

words.ex: He left home prior to sunrise.
words.ex_cn: 他在日出前离开了家。
words.en: Before a particular time or event.

words.tr: phrase. 加工食品；经过工业处理的食品
words.ex: He avoids processed food because it is unhealthy.
words.ex_cn: 他避免吃加工食品，因为它不健康。
words.en: Processed food refers to food items that have been altered from their natural state for safety reasons or convenience, often through canning, freezing, refrigeration, dehydration, or aseptic processing.

words.ex: The government changed the public policy to help poor families.
words.ex_cn: 政府改变了公共政策以帮助贫困家庭。
words.en: Public policy refers to the laws, regulations, and actions taken by governments to address issues within society.

words.tr: phrase. 驶离；离开；脱身；拉开距离
words.ex: The car started to pull away from the bus stop.
words.ex_cn: 汽车开始从公交站开走了。
words.en: To move away or depart, especially in a vehicle; to create distance between oneself and someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 采购价格；进货价；购买价格
words.ex: The purchasing price of the phone was low.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机的购买价格很低。
words.en: The amount of money paid by a buyer to acquire a good or service, often from a supplier or manufacturer.

words.ex: He does ten push-ups every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上做十个俯卧撑。
words.en: A push-up is a physical exercise performed in a prone position by raising and lowering the body using the arms.

words.tr: phrase. 收起来；杀死；关进监狱；放弃
words.ex: He put away his toys after playing.
words.ex_cn: 他玩完后把玩具收起来了。
words.en: To put something away means to place it in its proper storage location, to save or store it, to consume it, or to confine someone in prison.

words.tr: phrase. （雨点般）落下；大量倾泻；密集地落下
words.ex: The leaves rain down in autumn.
words.ex_cn: 秋天树叶纷纷落下。
words.en: To fall or cause to fall in large quantities, like rain.

words.tr: phrase. 阅读书目；书单（尤指课程指定的必读书目）
words.ex: He made a reading list for summer.
words.ex_cn: 他为夏天列了一份阅读清单。
words.en: A list of books, articles, or other materials recommended or required for reading, especially in an academic context.

words.tr: phrase. 招聘代理；招募人员
words.ex: The recruiting agent was responsible for finding new soldiers.
words.ex_cn: 这位征兵员负责招募新兵。
words.en: A recruiting agent is a person or organization that helps companies find and hire employees.

words.ex: He had to resort to asking for help.
words.ex_cn: 他不得不求助于别人。
words.en: If you resort to a particular course of action, you do it because other methods have failed.

words.ex: In some countries, the retirement age is increasing due to longer life expectancy.
words.ex_cn: 在一些国家，由于预期寿命的延长，退休年龄正在提高。
words.en: The age at which a person is expected or required to cease work and is eligible to receive pension benefits.

words.ex: He rode a roller coaster at the amusement park.
words.ex_cn: 他在游乐园坐了过山车。
words.en: A roller coaster is a type of amusement ride that consists of an elevated railway track designed with tight turns, steep slopes, and sometimes inversions. People ride in small open cars and are moved around the track by gravity and momentum, experiencing thrills and excitement.

words.tr: phrase. 经验法则；粗略估计；拇指规则（指基于经验的粗略判断而非精确计算）
words.ex: He uses the rule of thumb to estimate the cost.
words.ex_cn: 他用经验法则来估算成本。
words.en: A rule of thumb is a principle with broad application that is not intended to be strictly accurate or reliable for every situation.

words.tr: phrase. 建立；创立；设立；架起；提出
words.ex: He set up a small shop last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年开了一家小商店。
words.en: To set up something means to establish it or arrange it.

words.ex: The town needs better sewage disposal to keep the water clean.
words.ex_cn: 这个城镇需要更好的污水处理来保持水质清洁。
words.en: The process of removing and processing waste water and sewage from homes, businesses, and industries to protect public health and the environment.

words.ex: The explosion created a shock wave that broke windows.
words.ex_cn: 爆炸产生了冲击波，震碎了窗户。
words.en: A shock wave is a sharp change of pressure in a narrow region traveling through a medium, especially air, caused by explosion or by a body moving faster than sound.

words.ex: He shut off the lights before leaving.
words.ex_cn: 他离开前关掉了灯。
words.en: To stop the operation or flow of something by turning a switch, valve, or other control.

words.ex: The medicine has a side effect of dizziness.
words.ex_cn: 这种药有头晕的副作用。
words.en: An effect of a drug or chemical that is in addition to its intended effect, especially an effect that is harmful or unpleasant.

words.tr: phrase. 简单利息：仅根据贷款的原始本金或账户金额计算或支付的利息。
words.ex: He earned simple interest on his savings.
words.ex_cn: 他从储蓄中获得了简单利息。
words.en: Interest calculated only on the principal amount of a loan or deposit, and not on previously earned interest.

words.ex: Farmers use slash-and-burn to clear land for planting.
words.ex_cn: 农民使用刀耕火种来清理土地用于种植。
words.en: Slash-and-burn is a method of agriculture that involves cutting down and burning plants in a forest or woodland to create a field.

words.tr: phrase. 经济不景气的；经济疲软的；经济迟滞的
words.ex: The sluggish economy made it hard for small businesses to survive.
words.ex_cn: 经济不景气使小企业难以生存。
words.en: An economic condition characterized by slow growth, low consumer spending, and reduced business activity.

words.tr: phrase. 小批量生产；指每次生产数量较少的制造方式
words.ex: The factory uses small-lot production to make custom toys.
words.ex_cn: 工厂采用小批量生产来制造定制玩具。
words.en: The manufacturing of products in small quantities, often customized to specific customer requirements.

words.tr: phrase. 社会学习；指通过观察他人行为及其后果而进行的学习过程
words.ex: Children learn by social learning from their parents.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们通过向父母学习来进行社会学习。
words.en: Social learning refers to the process of acquiring new behaviors, information, or skills by observing and imitating others, often in a social context.

words.tr: phrase. 投机狂热； speculative 指投机性的，fever 指狂热或热潮，合指因投机行为引发的市场或社会狂热现象
words.ex: The market is caught in a speculative fever.
words.ex_cn: 市场正陷入投机狂热。
words.en: A speculative fever refers to a period of intense and often irrational enthusiasm for speculative investments, leading to inflated asset prices.

words.ex: The car's velocity increased on the highway.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车在高速公路上的速度增加了。
words.en: Velocity is the speed at which something moves in a particular direction.

words.tr: phrase. 事前的状况；先前的状态（尤指恢复到冲突或变化前的原状）
words.ex: The treaty aims to restore the status quo ante.
words.ex_cn: 该条约旨在恢复先前的状态。
words.en: The previous state of affairs.

words.ex: He wants to change the status quo.
words.ex_cn: 他想改变现状。
words.en: The status quo is the state of affairs that exists at a particular time, especially in contrast to a different possible state of affairs.

words.tr: phrase. 绊脚石；障碍物；阻碍进展的事物
words.ex: Lack of practice is a stumbling block for many students.
words.ex_cn: 缺乏练习是许多学生的障碍。
words.en: A stumbling block is a problem or difficulty that prevents you from achieving something.

words.tr: phrase. 服从；容易遭受；受制于
words.ex: All students are subject to the school rules.
words.ex_cn: 所有学生都必须服从校规。
words.en: Likely to be affected by or to experience something.

words.ex: He takes issue with the new rules.
words.ex_cn: 他不同意这些新规则。
words.en: To disagree with or challenge a particular point or statement.

words.ex: Safety takes precedence over speed.
words.ex_cn: 安全比速度更重要。
words.en: To be more important than something else and to be dealt with first.

words.tr: phrase. 合作；组队；联手（通常指为了共同目标而与他人协作）
words.ex: They team up to finish the project.
words.ex_cn: 他们合作完成这个项目。
words.en: To join together with someone in order to work on something as a team.

words.tr: phrase. 技术优点；技术价值；技术上的优越性
words.ex: The project has great technical merit.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目具有很高的技术价值。
words.en: The quality of being technically proficient or having technical excellence.

words.tr: phrase. 技术决定论：一种认为技术发展是社会变迁主要驱动力的理论，强调技术自主性及其对文化、经济和政治结构的决定性影响
words.ex: He believes in technological determinism, that machines change society.
words.ex_cn: 他相信技术决定论，即机器改变社会。
words.en: Technological determinism is the belief that technology is the primary driver of societal change and development.

words.tr: phrase. v.与……合作：与某人或某物合作完成某项任务或达成某个目标。
words.ex: He teams with his brother to fix the car.
words.ex_cn: 他和他哥哥一起修车。
words.en: To collaborate or work together with someone on a project or task.

words.tr: adj. 意志坚强的；实际的
words.ex: He is tough-minded and never gives up.
words.ex_cn: 他意志坚定，从不放弃。
words.en: If you describe someone as tough-minded, you approve of them because they are practical and not easily affected by emotions.

words.tr: phrase. 以……折价换购……；用……交换……
words.ex: He traded in his old car for a new one.
words.ex_cn: 他把他的旧车换成了新车。
words.en: To exchange an old item for a new one, usually paying an additional amount of money.

words.tr: phrase. 权衡；交换；在……之间做出取舍
words.ex: You need to trade off cost against quality when making your decision.
words.ex_cn: 在做决定时，你需要在成本和质量之间进行权衡。
words.en: A trade-off is a situation where you must choose between or balance two things that are opposite or cannot be had at the same time.

words.tr: phrase. 横跨大西洋迁徙（指人或动物）
words.ex: Birds transatlantic migrate every winter.
words.ex_cn: 鸟类每年冬天横跨大西洋迁徙。
words.en: To move from one place to another across the Atlantic Ocean, especially by birds or people.

words.tr: phrase. 跨国合作；跨越国家边界的协作
words.ex: Countries show transnational cooperation to fight climate change.
words.ex_cn: 各国为应对气候变化展现跨国合作。
words.en: Transnational cooperation refers to the collaboration between entities (such as governments, organizations, or individuals) across national borders to achieve common goals.

words.ex: Please turn down the volume, it's too loud.
words.ex_cn: 请把音量调低，太大声了。
words.en: To refuse or reject an offer or request; to reduce the volume, temperature, or intensity of something.

words.ex: The restaurant serves upscale clientele with expensive dishes.
words.ex_cn: 这家餐厅用昂贵的菜肴服务高端顾客。
words.en: Upscale clientele refers to a group of customers who prefer or can afford high-quality, expensive products or services.

words.tr: phrase. 维希政府（指二战期间1940–1944年统治法国未被德国直接占领地区的亲纳粹傀儡政权）
words.ex: The Vichy government collaborated with Nazi Germany.
words.ex_cn: 维希政府与纳粹德国合作。
words.en: The Vichy government was the French government that collaborated with the Axis powers during World War II, from 1940 to 1944, in the unoccupied zone of France and its overseas territories.

chapters.name: 附录四 GMAT 数学词汇 A 算术 整数

words.tr: phrase. 维希政府（指二战期间1940–1944年统治法国未被德国直接占领地区的亲纳粹傀儡政权）
words.ex: The Vichy government collaborated with Nazi Germany.
words.ex_cn: 维希政府与纳粹德国合作。
words.en: The Vichy government was the French government that collaborated with the Axis powers during World War II, from 1940 to 1944, in the unoccupied zone of France and its overseas territories.

words.tr: phrase. 复合数：一个（非零）自然数，可以表示为两个（或更多）自然数的乘积，这些自然数不包括它本身和1。
words.ex: Four is a composite number because it has more than two factors.
words.ex_cn: 四是合数，因为它有超过两个因数。
words.en: A composite number is a positive integer that has at least one positive divisor other than one or itself.

words.ex: The numbers 2, 4, and 6 are consecutive even integers.
words.ex_cn: 数字 2、4 和 6 是连续的偶数。
words.en: An even integer that follows another even integer without any odd integers in between.

words.ex: The numbers 5, 6, and 7 are consecutive integers.
words.ex_cn: 数字5、6和7是连续整数。
words.en: An integer that follows another integer in order without any gaps.

words.ex: The numbers 3, 5, and 7 are consecutive odd integers.
words.ex_cn: 数字3、5和7是连续的奇数。
words.en: A consecutive odd integer refers to an odd number that follows another odd number without any even numbers in between.

words.ex: The divisor is 5 in this math problem.
words.ex_cn: 在这个数学题中，除数是5。
words.en: A divisor is a number by which another number is to be divided.

words.tr:
adv. 甚至；甚至于；
adj. 平坦的；
words.ex: He didn't even say goodbye.
words.ex_cn: 他甚至连再见都没说。
